newsitem.title: USA: Sports reward girls in many ways, US report says.
newsitem.headline: Sports reward girls in many ways, US report says.

text.p: Early involvement in sports may help girls improve their grades, self-image and physical and mental health, a presidential panel reported Friday.
The President's Council on Physical Fitnesses and Sports said regular physical activity fosters positive feelings about body image, improved self-esteem and increased self-confidence.
"It can also help with academic achievement," a summary of the report by the Health and Human Services Department said without elaborating.
The report, Physical Activity and Sport in the Lives of Girls, was released as part of a national public education campaign to encourage 9- to 14-year-old girls to make the most of their lives.
